notes.title: Update 1.4 - VOICE OVER IS HERE!
notes.content:
Greetings, Humans!
Congratulations, the wait is over - the full voice acting for Part 1 is finally here! Ta-daah! 🎉

So, what have we been working on all this time? Here’s the scoop 👇

[previewyoutube=HfxsWxgxFEQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Now, every single speaking character in the game is fully voiced (in Russian)! And we mean everyone - cross our hearts! Your beloved Veinte, Ratibor, the Mermaids, and all the rest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/5bc8cfb985f3e9656be53827bf4d478c35c63e11.png[/img]

The sex scenes have been re-voiced and will also be in the game. We know this was a burning question for many (if not all) of you - so breathe easy now.

A huge thank you to the voice-acting studio RavenCat for their incredible collaboration - to all the actresses, actors, and everyone involved. It’s been an amazing partnership, and we hope to work together again on more exciting projects!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/dc4e60bb370f001104ba56bb6e0390c0abf924a6.png[/img]

Many asked, many begged, many waited - and we delivered! The Android version of the game is now available, and we trust you’ll have no trouble finding it.

And while you’re enjoying Part 1 with full voice acting - we’re already cooking up Part 2, and it’s going to be even hotter! So brace yourselves - you’re in for a wild ride!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642840/Rusy_ne_protiv_YAshherok_2

notes.title: Devlog 1.5
notes.content:
Greetings, Humans!

You asked, and we answer!

Work on the voiceover Part 1 is rapidly getting closer to completion — with the warm spring days, joyful news about it will come to you. Just a little more to go! 🌞

For now we’re lifting the veil of mystery just a little and showing you how the process went — just look at how hard the actors worked! 👇

[previewyoutube=wbr4Z5ftjeg;full]https://youtu.be/wbr4Z5ftjeg [/previewyoutube]

Work on the second part is in full swing — our programmer is toiling away, polishing the technical side so that you can enjoy the game without encountering bugs. The performance will improve, and Match3 will no longer lag — it will be smooth and pleasant, just the way we like it! 😇

[previewyoutube=vFF3xi8I4zA;full]https://youtu.be/vFF3xi8I4zA 
[/previewyoutube]
This is as much as we can reveal: Part 2 is going to see the light of day in the second half of 2025🤫

Thank you for your interest and patience. Stay tuned! ❤️

notes.title: Devlog 1.2
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Everything is in full swing right now in our little team.

Life in the village goes on as usual, everyone doing their own thing – the young maidens are, in turn, splashing around in the pond. Look at how much fun they’re having!  Our mighty heroes also couldn’t help but steal a glance on the way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/5c41f4529408b48cc6ac9d38dcc836acf5214aa4.png[/img]

But not the heroes alone are watching. The cunning lizards are, as always, just around the corner. Once the heroes go on to practise their martial skills, the lizardfolk squad grabs the beautiful maidens, puts them in a cage and takes them away. Only Perun knows why they did it, but to be honest, who wouldn’t want to get their hands on such beauties?


The beautiful maidens are growing weary as the lizards’ prisoners, missing their home village. Suddenly, out of nowhere, our hero flies to the captives’ aid, scattering the enemies. The lovely girls repay him in kind, in awe of his manly might.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/aabe61b877297aff6592c135b1f00ce5eb066136.gif[/img]

And now for something completely different. 

Renowned historians often dispute about the purpose of lizardwomen having tits. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/97a10b36a86015919264b60af2b919d7a7eb275e.png[/img]

The famous researcher of reptiles, Hue Axis, shared a few of the most popular hypotheses with us.

Number One: For the most part, mammary glands in lizards are more of an atavism or a remnant from the evolutionary past.

Number Two: It is an imitation of other species that serves as a defence against predators or helps to attract partners during the breeding season.

Number Three: They are not mammary glands. They are bags of poison.

Number Four: Breasts are needed solely to lure in young human males.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/3cfaf2eef1c91de2e3e991adaf9c55cf62cb30c4.png[/img]

Stay tuned for updates!

notes.title: Devlog 1.1
notes.content:
Glory, valour and piety, humans!

We are excited to share some news from our humble team. 

Feast your eyes on the creation of our artists – the first animations with the scheming Veinte are ready! We had some troubles with the ass slap, but we're happy with the result!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/73f8ede7e77248bbd71ab0d5a7f89eb24d0da3a8.gif[/img]

Our artists had some difficulties with showing all of Veinte’s assets. We turned her this way and that, and now she's steaming in the hot banya – when she gets warm, you can enjoy some fun times together. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/469215f8ce967e1984e2e072fdaa0324e7870fe9.png[/img]

The hardest one to do, surprisingly, were not the lizards, but Miroslava. For some reason the widow didn't want to bend in a way that allowed you to see all the interesting parts. We're going to take some more time to play around with her, and then show you what we’ve got!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/b2d6ec22a5fd37c4f6d6a38df57509911b8ea901.png[/img]

It took us a while to decide how to carve the idol that plays an important part in our story. According to the plot, it's enough to glance at it once for something to start stirring inside. Later, Veinte might use the idol in an… exciting way…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/80b102f19bfb4d4b3168888be26bb38f63cd4a89.png[/img]

We finalised the main plot of the game. As we said in the previous devlog, there will be two storylines that will be parallel – the struggle between the heroes and the lizards and the widow that shelters Malsas. The storylines will have three points of intersection, and ultimately will decide the fate of the Hyperboreans.

Meanwhile, the dialogues are 25% ready!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/6121cef54228ccf45a1685b5b3b6bc7aacab4bdb.png[/img]

While working on the game, we had some fun notions, and we'll build on them in free updates. There will be a cat girl telling fairy tales, and mermaids who haven't felt the touch of man for a long time.

Stay tuned for updates!

notes.title: Devlog 1.0
notes.content:
[b]Hello, everyone! [/b]
 
Today, we're releasing the first devlog, sharing our plans for the project. We'll try to keep you updated as frequently as possible! 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/f18bdaeb53919ed37f70d07eaeb18f16c506eb30.png[/img]

Let's start with the game's story. Currently, we have two main plotlines in mind that diverge after the fateful and treacherous attack of the female lizard squad led by Vainte the warrioress under the watchful eye of the snake commissar Alakeshna. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/f19da6924474cfde59c04c1a593f5aa96aefc837.png[/img]

Lizards steal an important human’s relic and take people in the village captived. The hero Radomir avoids capture and follows them to free his kin and let the cold-blooded reptiles taste the long hard club of human justice. 
 
Meanwhile, the lizardman weakling Malsas, who is constantly harrassed in the lizard matriarchy and then dragged along on a raid, wanders off and gets knocked out. He wakes up on the lap of the ravishing widow Miroslava, who, despite her aversion to scaly creatures, cannot help but pity him. She will shelter him from the battle, and then they'll have to work through the language barrier whichever way they can. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/611d7353f84a6e6dfbda6e85df660dcc0141395c.png[/img]
 
Just so we're clear from the get go, the game will mostly be a visual novel, with match-3 games at plot branching points. [b]There will be no microtransactions or anything! [/b]You will be able to collect coins through gameplay and spend them on boosts to help you with the match-3 levels. 
 
Stay tuned for updates; soon we'll show more of the widow, more of Vainte, and more of the commissar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787231/67f8104b6b07bae3f84d057bf185507c23341eec.png[/img]
